irene: FYI - after the IDP proxy deploy at 03:20 UTC we're getting intermittent HTTP/2 stream resets that seem to break SCIM syncs. Some retries end up missing the envelope header for encrypted attrs (extId). Anyone seen this pattern?

kevin: yep, errors spiked ~03:22. KMS rotation finished ~03:00 - could be related. Logs show RST_STREAM then our scim worker reports InvalidAttributeEncoding on retry.

song-ops: are the 502s from proxy->idp or scim-worker->proxy?

irene: proxy -> upstream IDP. Example: proxy reports h2 RST_STREAM 0x1e, then upstream 200 but payload missing attr_encryption_header. scim-worker then rejects.

maria: paste the snippet and which attrs are affected?

irene: ```
[03:22:11.123] proxy: h2: stream 342 reset: RST_STREAM 0x1e
[03:22:11.125] proxy: upstream connect idp-east-1:443 tls handshake OK
[03:22:11.126] proxy: request /scim/v2/Users sync_id=abc-123 payload_len=1842
[03:22:11.200] proxy: upstream response 200 but truncated: attr_encryption_header missing for extId
[03:22:11.201] scim-worker: POST /internal/ingest retry=1 err=InvalidAttributeEncoding
```

maria: missing envelope header on extId sounds like metadata stripped during retry path or proxy passthrough.

kevin: two possibilities: (1) h2 resets interrupt chunked frames and our retry/middleware loses headers, or (2) proxy h2 config change drops certain headers on connection reuse.

song-ops: I can force 5% traffic to HTTP/1.1 on the proxy to see if h2 is the culprit. Want me to flip?

irene: yes, do 5% A/B and enable h2 frame debug logging on the proxy nodes.

sso-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-546 - IDP proxy h2 resets causing SCIM sync attr encoding failures. PD notified.

kevin: meanwhile check scim-worker retry path where we reattach envelope headers. KMS cache might be refreshing after rotation and returning null.

maria: good point. KMS rotate at 03:00 could have changed envelope key id; if rewrap uses a different key or returns null, we might send payload without X-Envelope header. I'll grep kmsClient.rewrapIfStale usage.

song-ops: flipped 5% to h1 - first batch looked clean (no resets), h2 nodes still noisy. Reverting and collecting debug logs.

irene: triage checklist: (a) proxy h2 frame logs, (b) dump headers on failed requests from worker, (c) KMS cache snapshot around 03:00 from proxy and worker, (d) audit query for rewrap events.

audit-bot: audit hint: rewrap events kept 90d. Query id "rewrap:2026-03-18:03:00" for correlated entries.

kevin: vuln triage note - if envelope metadata is dropped we'll have an in-transit window where attributes appear unwrapped to services expecting an envelope. Need to confirm scope asap.

maria: found a code path: scim-worker.retry -> kmsClient.rewrapIfStale() can return null while cache refreshes -> code proceeds and emits payload without X-Envelope header. Pushing change to abort retry if rewrap null.

irene: good. Hold broader traffic changes until we validate that patch. Keep proxy debug logs.

song-ops: capturing proxy h2 debug to s3://redwood-triage/INC-2026-546/proxy-h2-debug.tar.gz

kevin: mitigation: add strict ingress header validation so payloads missing envelope header are rejected (400) instead of processed. I can PR nginx config.

maria: patch to scim-worker to fail retry landed, rolling to canary (3 instances) with a smoke that runs one full scim sync and verifies decryption.

irene: canary smoke results?

maria: 6/6 success, no InvalidAttributeEncoding.

song-ops: proxy h2 debug shows frequent SETTINGS frames and RST_STREAMs for long-lived streams shortly after upstream deploy at ~02:59. I'm reaching out to the IDP vendor to confirm they toggled h2 behavior.

irene: timeline so far: 03:00 KMS rotate, 03:20 IDP proxy deploy, 03:22 SCIM failures. Likely root cause: race between KMS cache refresh and our retry path combined with h2 resets triggering that path.

kevin: next steps: 1) keep scim-worker patch + ingress header validation, 2) harden KMS cache (add locking and stronger null handling), 3) follow up with IDP vendor on SETTINGS/RST pattern, 4) postmortem. I'll add tasks to INC-2026-546.

maria: adding unit tests for the rewrap-null scenario and updating release notes.

irene: marking this incident mitigated for now; leaving for postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sso-bot: INC-2026-546 status -> MITIGATED (temporary controls applied).
